caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a candlestick holder shaped like a stylized seated figure with geometric features. The candlestick holder is rendered in shades of green, resembling patinated metal or painted wood, with darker shadows and lighter highlights indicating facets and edges. The figure is angular with a flat base, a slanted seat, a squared body, triangular arms or shoulders, a blocky head, and a bowtie-shaped element at the neck area. There are small round rivet-like decoration details across the surface of the figure, especially around the arms and torso. A tall, pale yellow candle is placed vertically at the front left corner of the base, with a black wick at the top, unlit. The background is plain and off-white, and there are no other objects or significant details in the composition.
title: Painted Wooden Candle Stick, with Grooves andCircles
